terms.p: Pre-registration does not create an active account or grant immediate access to the platform. IsThere4You is under development and no exact launch date is guaranteed.

“Founding Member 2026” is a symbolic and promotional status offered to certain eligible users who sign up during the pre-launch period. It does not make you a founder, partner, shareholder, investor or creditor and grants no rights over the project’s code, brand, revenue or assets. The status carries no voting, management or profit-distribution rights; it is personal and non-transferable.

IT4Y Points are internal digital reward units. Depending on available features, they may be used for Premium benefits or other in-platform advantages and, if that feature becomes available, to voluntarily reward other users. IT4Y Points are not money, electronic money, cryptocurrency or a financial instrument; they cannot be withdrawn as cash and there is no guarantee of value or convertibility.

Pre-registration may make you eligible for a “reserved” IT4Y reward. Reservation does not mean immediate issuance or use; actual granting depends on account creation and verification under the program rules in force at that time.
Multiple, automated, fictitious or fraudulent registrations may be removed. A single person may not obtain multiple benefits by using several email addresses.
The pre-launch mechanism and the IT4Y program may be changed for technical, operational or legal reasons. Changes affecting benefits already reserved will be communicated.

privacy.p: For pre-registration, we collect only the data needed to administer the program: email address, language, sign-up date and time, versions of the documents accepted and reward-eligibility status.
Administering pre-registration, notifying you about launch, later account activation and reserving benefits associated with the program.
We use Cloudflare Turnstile to protect the form against bots and abusive automation. Verification is performed server-side before a registration is accepted.
Pre-registration does not constitute consent to newsletters or general marketing. Any such option, if introduced, will be separate.

If you use the contact form, we process your email address, subject, message, language and date/time of submission, plus your name if you choose to provide it. Messages are transmitted through Supabase infrastructure, and the form uses Cloudflare Turnstile and request rate limiting to prevent abuse.
You may request withdrawal from the program, access, rectification or deletion of your data, subject to applicable legal obligations.

it4y.p: In short: IT4Y are IsThere4You’s internal reward points.
In the future, IT4Y may be used for Premium features and other in-platform benefits and, if enabled, to voluntarily reward other members of the community.
IT4Y are not money or cryptocurrency and cannot be withdrawn as cash.
This is a symbolic pre-launch status. It is not an ownership interest, investment, partnership or shareholding and grants no legal rights over the operator or the project.
